name: Anthony Jennings
strengths: Jennings separates immediately with quick-twitch burst off the line and vertical juice.
Jennings has a clean release package that slides past press before corners get a clean jam.
Jennings turns crossers and short throws into explosives with acceleration after the catch.
Jennings shows body control adjusting to off-target balls on vertical stems and comebacks.
weaknesses: Jennings' lighter 160-pound frame still needs functional strength vs physical SEC press at the stem and catch point.
comparison: Jennings comps to Zay Flowers -- ~5-11 lean speed WR who wins with twitch releases, YAC, and home-run vertical juice (size-matched to Jennings' 5-11 / 160 mold with room to fill).
projection: Jennings projects as develop into the WR room, earn early speed-package and return snaps, then compete for a starting slot/perimeter role -- starter upside as an explosive separator with YAC.
schemeFit: Jennings fits Faulkner as a vertical/YAC weapon who can align slot or outside in rhythm concepts.
